output.summary: Group ticket time (about 17.6 minutes outside Riverside) is a step change matching the October 2024 'Made Here' redesign, which the board accepted in advance with a 19-minute ceiling. It is a deliberate tradeoff rather than group-wide inefficiency, and guest satisfaction has not fallen. Riverside's slowdown is a local staffing gap: 71% of the added time sits at the saute/pasta station, which lost its cook in August and remains unfilled despite two deferred transfer requests. Restore that position now and track it weekly. Standardizing on frozen components, replacing the GM, or writing a 12-minute target into bonuses risks harm. Marcus Delgado's reason for leaving is unestablished.
